atoms.text: Einleitende Adverbien stehen am Anfang eines Satzes und werden mit einem Komma abgetrennt. Dabei gibt es zwei Arten.
Linking adverbs verbinden zwei Sätze miteinander. Darum werden sie auch conjunctive adverbs genannt.
atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>linking adverbs</voice> verbinden zwei Sätze miteinander. Darum werden sie auch <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>conjunctive adverbs</voice> genannt.

example.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>I like dogs. Furthermore, I love all animals.</voice>

atoms.text: Commenting adverbs beziehen sich auf den Satz, dem sie vorangestellt sind. Sie zeigen, was die sprechende Person über das Gesagte denkt:
atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>Commenting adverbs</voice> beziehen sich auf den Satz, dem sie vorangestellt sind. Sie zeigen, was die sprechende Person über das Gesagte denkt:

example.a: I like dogs. <m-yellow>Unfortunately</m-yellow>, <u>they don't like me back</u>.
example.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>I like dogs. Unfortunately, they don't like me back.</voice>

atoms.b: He will go to the mall. ((Additionally)), he will go out to eat with his friends.
At the mall he will buy school supplies. ((Besides)), he is thinking of purchasing some new clothes.
((Furthermore)), he will spend the night at his friend's house.

instruction.text: Ergänze den Text mit den passenden Adverbien.

atoms.b: ((++Luckily Honestly)), my friends and I finally have time to go to the cinema together. We're not going to watch a comedy film. ((++Instead Moreover)), we are planning to watch a horror film. ((++Also Interestingly)), we want to buy some popcorn as well as soft drinks.
atoms.sound: Luckily, my friends and I finally have time to go to the cinema together. We're not going to watch a comedy film. Instead, we are planning to watch a horror film. Also, we want to buy some popcorn as well as soft drinks.

atoms.b: ((++Surprisingly Sadly)), Kassandra and I are best friends despite our different interests. All she thinks about is paintings and exhibitions. ((++Therefore Finally)), she is into arts while I'm much more sporty. ((++Nevertheless Thoughtfully)), we have a lot of fun together.
atoms.sound: Surprisingly, Kassandra and I are best friends despite our different interests. All she thinks about is paintings and exhibitions. Therefore, she is into arts while I'm much more sporty. Nevertheless, we have a lot of fun together.

atoms.b: I'm not quite sure what to do after school. ((++Honestly Nonetheless)), I would love to spend some time with my friends at the park. ((++Unfortunately Otherwise)), I have a geography exam tomorrow. ((++Perhaps Unbelievably)), I should study at home.
atoms.sound: I'm not quite sure what to do after school. Certainly, I would love to spend some time with my friends at the park. Unfortunately, I have a geography exam tomorrow. Perhaps, I should study at home.

atoms.b: Hello. Are you free on Tuesday? We could do something together after school.
Hello. ((++Actually Similarly)), I should have band practice. But ((++surprisingly kindly)), it's cancelled this week. ((++Therefore Likewise)), I have time.
That's great news. We could play badminton in the park nearby our school. ((++Furthermore Indeed)), we could have a picnic there. What do you think?

That's a good idea. I love playing badminton! ((++Moreover Thus)), I haven't had a picnic in a long time. ((++Unfortunately Bravely)), the weather will be bad on Tuesday. ((++Therefore Indeed)), we should do something indoors.
What a pity! ((++Still Otherwise)), we could go bowling. But afterwards I'm always hungry. ((++Maybe --Generally)), we could eat dinner at a restaurant.
That sounds great! Let's do that.
